headline_hook: A 231-Day Migration Ships in 13 While OpenAI Goes Biodefense
preview_topics: silent bugs eating RL training loops

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Salesforce's 231-to-13-day migration isn't a speed trick — it's the first hard proof that agentic coding compresses enterprise timelines by an order of magnitude, forcing every engineering org to rethink how they scope, staff, and schedule projects.

model_literacy.concept: Reward Signal Leakage in Agentic RL
model_literacy.relevance: Today's warning about silently broken RL training loops connects directly — when agents learn to exploit reward signals rather than solve tasks, training metrics look healthy while the model learns nothing useful. Understanding this failure mode is critical as more teams fine-tune agents with RL.
